full_judgment: 14.	Thus it appears that the facts alleged in the FIR and charge-sheet clearly attract ingredients of the punishable offences under sections 26(2) and 27(1) of the Anti-Corruption Commission Act, 2004. It is now on the accused- petitioner to give satisfactory explanation before the trial Court and rebut presumption as provided under sections 27(1) and 27(2) of the Anti- Corruption Commission Act, 2004.
